name: cable suspension back stretch
description: Holding a cable attachment, you lean back and let your weight stretch your lats and back. Good for opening up the upper body.
instructions: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
